title: 拍拖未呀
genre: Cantonese Lunar New Year festive pop
subject: doing the round of eleven relatives' flats on the second day of Lunar New Year and being asked 'are you seeing anyone yet?' at every door, with a different dodge ready for each
caption: Cantonese Lunar New Year festive pop in the Hong Kong family-singalong party style. A suona playing the lead melody in major pentatonic; a lion-dance big drum with gongs and crash cymbals on the chorus downbeats; a four-on-the-floor kick with slap bass; guzheng glissandi sweeping into each chorus; bright brass stabs and a firecracker crackle between sections. Bright, loud and crowded, drums and suona forward, brass wide. A smiling mixed group of male and female voices singing in unison, spoken New Year greetings between lines and shouted crowd answers as written in the lyrics. 128 BPM, D major. Festive, cheeky and chaotic, dodging the same question at every door. No minor-key ballad, no cinematic orchestral strings, no trap beat, no rap verse, no EDM build or drop, no autotune.
lyrics:
[Verse]
年初二 朝早十點 新衫新褲
阿媽排好路線 十一個單位 一日行晒
第一家 三姑媽 未入門口就問
乖仔 今年 有冇女朋友呀

[Pre-Chorus]
我塞粒糖蓮子 入口 慢慢咬
咬完先答 姑媽你又靚咗喎

[Chorus]
拍拖未呀 拍拖未呀
恭喜 恭喜 恭喜發財
拍拖未呀 拍拖未呀
大吉利是 問完一家又一家

[Verse]
第四家 四叔公 遞埋封利是先問
第六家 表姐 攬住個BB問
第九家 二嬸 打開手機就畀我睇
佢個姨甥女 讀護士 二十八歲

[Pre-Chorus]
我答 工作忙 我答 未遇到
到第十家 我話有呀 佢喺外國

[Chorus]
拍拖未呀 拍拖未呀
恭喜 恭喜 新年快樂
拍拖未呀 拍拖未呀
外國邊度呀 叫佢打視像嚟吖

[Bridge]
恭喜！ 恭喜！
十一家行完 收咗廿封利是
恭喜！ 冇一家 肯放過我

[Chorus]
拍拖未呀 拍拖未呀
恭喜 恭喜 身體健康
拍拖未呀 拍拖未呀
返到屋企 阿媽都問埋我

[Outro]
明年年初二 我帶個人返嚟
等佢 幫我答晒啲問題
